title: Saudi Flatbread with Scrambled Eggs
description: A simple yet delicious breakfast dish from Saudi Arabia, featuring scrambled eggs served with warm flatbread.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the warming oil and let it heat up for a minute.
Crack in the eggs and scramble them until they're cooked through.
Warm the flatbread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Serve the scrambled eggs with the warm flatbread.
